query:
SELECT 
  bc.id,
  bc.client_name,
  bc.value,
  bc.status,
  bc.type,
  bc.description,
  bc.due_date
FROM bpo_charges bc
WHERE bc.description LIKE '%Pix recebido%'
  AND bc.status IN ('received', 'confirmed')
  AND bc.type = 'other'
  AND bc.id NOT IN (510001, 30002)
ORDER BY bc.due_date DESC
LIMIT 20
